name: Adapt movement during live performance
short_description: Sustain a 20-minute complex movement performance while adapting safely to changing partners, space, or tempo.
self_assessment: I can adapt a 20-minute complex movement performance without help when spacing, partners, or tempo change.
description: Sustain a 20-minute complex movement performance while adapting safely to changing partners, space, or tempo. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Adjust a rehearsed movement piece to a changed tempo
